description: List what happened on the Celestia Fibre network (Mocha testnet, mocha-5), newest first: blob payments, validators registering or leaving their Fibre host, status changes, host reconfirmations and escrow deposits, as recorded by Cumulo's Fibre Network Monitor. Without filters this is a snapshot refreshed every 15 minutes; with a type or validator filter, or more than 50 events, it is fetched live from Cumulo. Event titles quote names typed by validators and publishers and are marked untrusted. For one validator's whole record use get_fibre_validator.

chain.description: Chain id; leave out for the one Cumulo monitors today (mocha-5, the Mocha testnet)

validator.description: A validator (celestiavalcons1... or celestiavaloper1...) or, for escrow events, a publisher account (celestia1...)

name: list_fibre_events
